steps.text: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
There she is. How are you feeling?
Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
Did the introduction come back to you?
Yes. I slowed down like you said
Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
Good. What about questions?
You'll like this
The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
That sounds familiar
Very familiar 😌
I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
I could answer without looking at my notes
That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
Apparently so
It wasn't flawless, though
What happened?
I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
Then clicked back too far
A surprise tour of the presentation
Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
Did you find the right slide again?
Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
A few people laughed. Then I carried on
That's a pretty good recovery
I thought so too
I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
You should be pleased with that
I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
Enjoy the quiet minute, then
With lunch this time. A proper one
An excellent follow-up to your academic success
Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
I will ❤️
